buttons.label: Next doorway side
buttons.script: const castle=objects.getAll('castle')[0]; const plan=castle.definition.buildPlan.metadata.runtime; const doors=[...plan.roomDoors,{...plan.residential.origin,roomId:'main-entrance'}]; const index=(map.auditView??-1)+1; map.auditView=index%(doors.length*2); const door=doors[Math.floor(map.auditView/2)]; const side=map.auditView%2?1:-1; const angle=door.yaw*Math.PI/180; const hero=objects.getOne('hero'); camera.setFirstPerson(false); hero.teleport({x:door.x+Math.sin(angle)*side*1.35,y:door.y+0.014,z:door.z+Math.cos(angle)*side*1.35}); hero.firstPersonCameraEnabled=true; hero.firstPersonFacingYaw=door.yaw+(side>0?180:0); camera.setFirstPerson(true);
